blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Manila Rep. Joel Chua on Sunday said he was “surprised” when he heard Vice President Sara Duterte accuse the national police of being used as an “enforcement arm” of politicians, pointing to what he characterized as her own family’s history of violence. On Saturday, Duterte accused the Philippine National Police (PNP) of acting as an “enforcement arm” for politicians, making the claim after alleging the police leadership had prejudged claims involving her former staff without proper investigation. “I’m surprised… that they’re the ones speaking out about this, considering that they’re the ones with a history of violence and […]...
